data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (open the form, enter origin and destination from suggestions, pick dates, click Find flights, select a fare) and names nearly all the right parameters, including book_with_miles; it splits travelers into adults/children and adds a couple of optional steps the true workflow doesn't have, but a browser automation could still be built from it.
